moments.title: Strictly's Glitterball Season Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing launches tonight on BBC One with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe, revealing the celebrity pairings.

angles.name: Launch Night Excitement
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Tonight, Strictly Come Dancing returns with its star-studded launch show. Who's partnered with who? The suspense is killing us! #Strictly

angles.name: New Hosts Debut
angles.copy: New era, new hosts! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe take the reins as Strictly Come Dancing launches tonight. Ready for some fresh ballroom energy?

angles.name: Anticipation for Live Shows
angles.copy: The launch show is just the beginning! Catch the first glimpse of this year's Strictly stars tonight, then mark your calendars for the live competitive shows starting next Saturday, Sept 26th.

moments.title: Bake Off Returns with a New Judge
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off Series 17 begins on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: Get ready for some truly delicious viewing! The Great British Bake Off is back this Tuesday, and Nigella Lawson is joining the tent as a new judge. We're already hungry.

angles.name: Baking Season Begins
angles.copy: Autumn just isn't autumn without it! The Great British Bake Off returns to Channel 4 this Tuesday at 8pm. Time to get cosy and watch the flour fly!

angles.name: Cake Week Excitement
angles.copy: It all kicks off with Cake Week! The Great British Bake Off returns Tuesday with stout cakes, artistic technicals, and self-portrait showstoppers. Nigella and Paul are ready!

moments.title: Premier League Pauses for International Break
moments.blurb: The Premier League concludes Matchweek 5 tomorrow, September 20, before an extended 16-day international break begins on September 21, with nations competing in the UEFA Nations League and other qualifiers.

angles.name: Club Football Pause
angles.copy: Get your Premier League fix today and tomorrow! After Matchweek 5, domestic football takes a break as players head off for an extended international window from Monday.

angles.name: Nations League Action
angles.copy: It's all about international football next week! The Premier League pauses for a 16-day break, with England and other nations competing in the UEFA Nations League. England face Spain at Wembley on Sept 26.

angles.name: Player Welfare Focus
angles.copy: A longer international break from Monday means less travel disruption for players this season. Four international matches in 16 days – will it pay off for the national teams?

moments.title: Autumn Officially Arrives with Equinox
moments.blurb: The Autumnal Equinox takes place on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 1:05 AM BST, marking the astronomical start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere.

angles.name: Hello Autumn
angles.copy: Summer, it's been a blast, but autumn officially arrives this Wednesday with the Autumnal Equinox at 1:05 AM BST. Time for cosy nights and crunchy leaves!

angles.name: Equal Day & Night
angles.copy: This Wednesday marks the Autumnal Equinox – when day and night are almost equal in length. Enjoy the balance before the nights draw in!

angles.name: Stonehenge Celebration
angles.copy: For those celebrating, English Heritage is offering free managed open access to Stonehenge for the Autumn Equinox this Wednesday. Gates open early!

moments.title: Niall Horan Kicks Off UK Tour in Birmingham
moments.blurb: Niall Horan's 'Dinner Party Live On Tour' begins its UK leg in Birmingham on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, marking his biggest UK arena run yet.

angles.name: Niall Live in Brum
angles.copy: Directioners, get ready! Niall Horan kicks off his massive 'Dinner Party Live On Tour' UK dates this Tuesday in Birmingham. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Biggest Tour Yet
angles.copy: Niall Horan is hitting the road for his biggest UK arena tour to date, starting in Birmingham on Sept 22nd. Expect a 'Dinner Party' to remember!

angles.name: Tour Kick-Off
angles.copy: The UK leg of Niall Horan's 'Dinner Party Live On Tour' starts this week! Birmingham is first up on Tuesday. Get ready for new music and fan favourites.

moments.title: Eurovision Winner Loreen Tours UK
moments.blurb: Double Eurovision winner Loreen brings her 'Wildfire Tour' to the UK in late September, with dates in Glasgow (Sept 24), Manchester (Sept 25), and London (Sept 26).

angles.name: Loreen's UK Fire
angles.copy: She's bringing the 'Wildfire'! Double Eurovision champion Loreen hits the UK this week, with shows in Glasgow (Thurs), Manchester (Fri), and London (Sat). Who's going?

angles.name: Glasgow Get Ready
angles.copy: Glasgow, your Thursday night is sorted! Loreen's 'Wildfire Tour' lands at the O2 Academy on September 24th. Get ready for those iconic tracks live.

angles.name: Manchester & London
angles.copy: Loreen fever is sweeping the UK! Catch the Eurovision star in Manchester on Friday and London's O2 Academy Brixton on Saturday as part of her 'Wildfire Tour'.

moments.title: James Blake in London
moments.blurb: James Blake's 'Trying Times Tour' includes two London dates on September 29-30, 2026, known for his immersive electronic production.

angles.name: Blake's London Dates
angles.copy: Get ready for some immersive electronic sounds! James Blake brings his 'Trying Times Tour' to London for two nights on September 29th & 30th.

angles.name: Experimental Sounds
angles.copy: James Blake fans, mark your calendars! The acclaimed artist is in London for two nights at the end of next week. Expect a unique live experience.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
moments.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, turns 54 on September 21, 2026.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Oasis track?

angles.name: Still a Legend
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 on Monday! Liam Gallagher, a true rock 'n' roll star, celebrates his birthday. Here's to more iconic moments.

moments.title: Happy Birthday The Boss
moments.blurb: Bruce Springsteen, legendary American singer-songwriter, turns 77 on September 23, 2026.

angles.name: Birthday Boss
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to 'The Boss', Bruce Springsteen! Still rocking stages worldwide. What's your ultimate Springsteen anthem?

angles.name: Born to Run
angles.copy: 77 years young! Bruce Springsteen celebrates his birthday on Wednesday. A true music icon with a career spanning decades.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Ozzy Osbourne
moments.blurb: Ozzy Osbourne, the 'Prince of Darkness' and Black Sabbath frontman, turns 78 on September 24, 2026.

angles.name: Prince of Darkness Turns 78
angles.copy: All aboard the Crazy Train! Happy 78th Birthday to the legendary Ozzy Osbourne. Wishing the Prince of Darkness a truly wild day!

angles.name: Rock Icon's Big Day
angles.copy: He's still going strong! Ozzy Osbourne celebrates his 78th birthday on Thursday. What's your favourite Black Sabbath or solo track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Catherine Zeta-Jones
moments.blurb: Welsh actress and singer Catherine Zeta-Jones turns 57 on September 25, 2026.

angles.name: Welsh Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to our very own Welsh superstar, Catherine Zeta-Jones! Sending cariad from Wales.

angles.name: Hollywood Glamour
angles.copy: Celebrating the fabulous Catherine Zeta-Jones, who turns 57 on Friday! A true icon of stage and screen.
